source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. This page displays the list of POST code logs.
2. Check POST code log
3. Click "Export all" button to export the POST code logs.
4. Click "Clear All Logs" button to clear the POST code logs.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. all info correct
2. all message should match status
3. logs should be exported successfully.
4. logs should be cleared successfully.

deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL PostLog Entries JSON. No RISK.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES reads an assumed PostLog Entries collection but does not verify the POST-code WebUI, `Export all` file or destructive clear. `.Entries` may hide collection metadata and pagination; the command assumes resource IDs, bypasses TLS validation, exposes credentials and cannot relate codes to a boot session or justify `FULL`/`No RISK`.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED correctly separates display, export and clear, preserves boot diagnostics and prohibits unapproved reboot stimulus. This review additionally requires a known-good boot-session fixture, chronological code progression rather than isolated string correctness, terminal-code/outcome mapping and explicit differentiation between collection completeness and per-session completeness.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 863/2291 accepts a single insecure GET as agent-direct and omits boot/session identity, code semantics, page/export coverage, pagination, destructive deletion, retention and possible reboot/service impact.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No sequence-1026 draft exists in the invalidated 1,000-record run.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 preserves the source and records its pre-clear defect; ED-34 treats POST schema/session/export inputs as readiness; ED-35 retains page, Export all and clear as separate functional coverage; ED-38 requires protected evidence, explicit one-time deletion approval, no automatic retry/reboot and engineer-owned verdict.

original_test_intent: Verify that the BMC POST logs page presents the complete ordered POST-code history for the intended boot session with correct decoded status, that `Export all` produces a complete readable session-aware artifact, and that `Clear All Logs` clears only the authorized POST-log scope with the documented post-state.
original_method: The preserved source clears logs before examining/exporting POST records and later clears again. The Review-layer method flags that contradiction, selects a retained known-good boot-session dataset, correlates canonical record/session/code order with the WebUI and parsed export, then—only after retention approval on a lab BMC—performs one supported POST-service clear and verifies service isolation without generating a reboot automatically.
manual_activity: The platform owner supplies the POST-code dictionary and identifies a representative known-good boot session; the retention owner authorizes any lab-only clear. Automation can compare and export records and perform one separately approved clear, but any reboot or power stimulus, firmware interpretation, deletion authority and final verdict remain engineer/operator-owned.
required_inputs: Exact BMC endpoint/certificate, firmware/WebUI build, account role and discovered POST LogService/resource IDs
Board/BIOS-specific POST code dictionary including boot phase, severity/status, terminal/success codes and any repeated/implementation-defined codes
Known-good boot/session identity, start/end boundary, reset/power context, ordered code expectations and evidence that the selected dataset is representative
PostLog collection pagination/sequence/retention/wrap semantics and UI field mapping for record ID, session, code, decoded message/status and timestamp
Export all file name/MIME/encoding/schema, all-session versus selected-session scope, parser, checksum, redaction and custody rules
Approved lab target, clearable classes, exact clear control/post-state, unrelated-log exclusions, maintenance/OOB recovery and separate approval for any reboot stimulus
safety_requirements: Do not execute the blanket pre-test clear. It destroys the POST sequence needed to validate the page and export, and the source supplies no approved boot stimulus to reconstruct it.

Do not trigger reboot, reset or power cycle merely to populate the log. Such a stimulus is outside the stated steps and requires its own active-workload check, approval, console monitoring and recovery plan.

Do not judge correctness from a single decoded string or unordered code set. Validate the canonical code progression and boot/session boundary against the exact board/BIOS dictionary and observed boot outcome.

Do not assume the hard-coded PostLog URI, `.Entries` array or one response is complete. Discover the resource, retain collection metadata and follow pagination/continuations without terminal truncation.
Do not use `curl -k` or expose reusable credentials on the command line. Use trusted endpoint identity and protected authentication, preserving HTTP status/headers and parse errors separately.

Clear only after a complete verified external export and explicit retention approval; invoke once, never retry automatically, and stop on ambiguous scope, partial session/export, active boot diagnosis, unexpected reboot or unrelated-log deletion.
agent_execution_scope: Discover the authoritative POST service, bind a retained known-good boot session, capture complete collection/session metadata and records and reconcile their ordered codes with the approved platform dictionary.

Compare canonical record/session/code/status fields with the WebUI, invoke Export all once and prove the file's session range, order, count, code fields, integrity and readability against the same bounded dataset.

Present the immutable target, verified export and exact clear/post-state contract; only after explicit approval invoke one supported clear and verify old-session disposition, marker/sequence behavior and preservation of other log services.
Do not generate a new boot or retry any mutation; report unknown codes, missing phases, ordering/session ambiguity and clear anomalies as facts for engineer disposition, never DUT PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the board/BIOS POST dictionary, expected known-good boot progression, session-boundary rules and terminal outcome mapping.
Approve export scope/retention and decide whether an existing session suffices or a separately controlled reboot stimulus is required.
Authorize the exact lab-only clear/post-state, review page/export/clear checkpoints independently and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Only a possible collection discovery step. It assumes resource IDs, discards collection metadata, may omit pages, provides no session/code interpretation and bypasses required WebUI/export/clear operations while weakening TLS and exposing credentials; `FULL` and no-risk are unsupported.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Discover and capture the complete supported POST LogService through trusted protected access, preserve collection metadata and all pages, isolate a known boot session and validate ordered codes with the board/BIOS dictionary; compare the WebUI and parsed Export all artifact, then request separate approval for one scoped clear and verify its documented post-state.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The POST logs page, Export all, Clear All Logs, four Criteria, blanket pre-clear text, absent Script and 10/0-minute estimates remain preserved; no reboot is invented and unsafe setup/incomplete GET evidence are corrected only in the Review layer.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a session-aware three-checkpoint method: canonical ordered POST-code/UI correlation for a known boot, complete Export all validation, then one separately approved lab-only clear with explicit sequence/marker and isolation checks.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only the selected board/BMC/BIOS combination whose POST-code producer, dictionary, session rules and clear semantics are documented.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC firmware/WebUI, BIOS/BMC interface, board POST dictionary, Redfish/OEM schema, export-format and decoder/client versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform POST-code dictionary and boot-flow specification, vendor PostLog/UI export-clear documentation and Project diagnostic retention/recovery policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Retains all three functional checkpoints but protects the diagnostic sequence, adds boot/session/order semantics, authenticates access and forbids an implicit reboot or premature clear.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A collection GET is not WebUI or Export all coverage; a list of codes without session/order cannot prove boot progression; export does not prove clear; a prohibited/omitted clear remains unverified functional coverage.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Service/session identity, version-matched code dictionary, representative boot evidence, full export rules, retention/clear approval and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Clearing can erase the only trace of intermittent boot failure; repeated or vendor-specific codes may be context-dependent; rollover/concurrent boots can blur session boundaries; creating new records may disrupt service.

project_override_considerations: A Project may use a vendor decoder/CLI or another supported API instead of the proposed Redfish path, but must record the preserved method, actual tool/revision, reason, engineer approval, equivalent session/order/export/clear evidence and any unverified WebUI/tool coverage. If retention policy forbids clear, the original clear checkpoint remains explicitly unverified; a reboot is never implied by tool substitution.
expected_evidence: Target BMC/board/BIOS identity, firmware/WebUI build, trusted certificate, account role and discovered POST service/schema
Known boot/session start/end, reset/power cause and outcome plus complete ordered raw codes, stable record IDs/sequences/timestamps and version-matched dictionary mapping
Redacted WebUI page evidence with field/order/session reconciliation and explicit unknown/repeated-code treatment
Export all trusted-origin file metadata, checksum, parser result, all-page/session range, record/count/order/code completeness and approved custody
Written retention/clear approval and exact single action/response with old-session disposition, expected marker/sequence reset and unrelated-service preservation
Protected command audit, no-pre-clear/no-unapproved-reboot/no-retry proof, recovery/limitations and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Before-Test blanket clear deletes the POST-code history required by the subsequent page and Export all checks, and the source provides no approved reboot/session stimulus to recreate a representative sequence. The viewer/export/clear functions are identifiable, but the contradictory setup must be preserved and excluded in the Review layer.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The POST viewer, export and clear functions are explicit. Missing code dictionary, boot-session fixture, service/export rules and deletion authority are resolvable Project/vendor readiness inputs, so the case is PACKAGE rather than permanently BLOCKED; no reboot or clear may occur until resolved.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Changes YES to PACKAGE, retains its GET only after discovery as reference evidence and restores session semantics, WebUI, Export all and destructive-clear coverage.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its baseline/export/clear safeguards while adding known-good boot progression, collection-versus-session completeness and a strict no-implicit-reboot boundary.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Replaces agent-direct acceptance of one insecure array response with session-aware code validation and separately authorized export/clear checkpoints.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No prior invalid draft exists for this sequence.

review_improvement: Prevents an unordered or partial Entries array from being mistaken for correct boot history, preserves critical firmware/hardware diagnostic evidence and prevents either an unapproved reboot or premature deletion from manufacturing an apparently clean result.
independent_technical_reasoning: POST codes form an ordered trace whose meaning depends on board/BIOS version and the boot session; an isolated code string can be correct yet belong to the wrong boot or omit a failed phase. Collection completeness, session completeness, UI decoding and exported-file fidelity are separate properties. Because clearing destroys diagnostic state and a reboot changes service state, neither can be used as casual setup; deletion must follow verified export and any stimulus must be separately authorized.
